Package com.robojacks.lib.sim

Class SimHardware.SimGps

java.lang.Object
com.robojacks.lib.sim.SimHardware.SimGps
All Implemented Interfaces:
GpsIO
Enclosing class:
SimHardware
public static class SimHardware.SimGps extends Object implements GpsIO
GPS that reads the simulated robot's true pose, as seen by a sensor mounted on it, in the sensor's compass frame. The mounting is whatever the robot code declares with VexGps(port, robotToGps), unless the sim script sets one with setMounting(com.robojacks.lib.math.Transform2d) (e.g. to test what happens when the code's transform is wrong).

    • declareMounting

      public void declareMounting(Transform2d robotToGps)
      Description copied from interface: GpsIO
      Tells the hardware layer how the robot code says the sensor is mounted. The real brain ignores it; the simulator uses it as the sensor's physical mounting (unless the sim script sets a different one), so simulated readings match the robot code.
